correctness.rationale: The characteristic-zero six-point blowdown gives the universal 27-line meeting relation. The root orthogonality argument is valid: the three intersections with a root lie in {−1,0,1} and sum to zero, so the support overlap is zero or two. Independently I constructed the meeting graph directly: E_i meets L_jk precisely when i is in {j,k}, E_i meets Q_j for i≠j, L_ij meets Q_k for k in {i,j}, and two different L-classes meet when their indices are disjoint. Three pairwise meeting lines in a smooth cubic are planar (also at an Eckardt point, by the tangent plane) and make one anticanonical section. Enumeration gives 45 meeting triples, 72 pairwise skew sixers, a unique partner each with five opposite incidences at every line, and 36 unions. It gives exactly 1080 overlaps of size two and 540 zero overlaps. Direct integer Smith reduction on these independently constructed B and J−B gives 1×15,3×5,18,0×15 and 1×14,3×7,0×15 respectively, and exact Gram characteristic polynomials corroborate both ranks. The zero rows in the Smith forms give free rank 15; extra zero columns do not affect the cokernel.
residual_risks: The universal calculation is for smooth cubics over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero; no arithmetic form or singular specialization is tested.

evidence: The earlier proofs supply more than separate Smith forms: the tritangent lattice N surjects onto K=ker(Z^27→Pic(S)/Z[−K_S]), while the double-six image has index 2^16 in that same saturated lattice. Thus at odd primes both span K, and the cross-pairing reduces to an actual induced integral Gram form of K (up to the unit 1/2). The complement adds a degree-functional outer product.

Neither inspected earlier proof computes that Gram Smith form or the perturbed Gram Smith form, and the odd-prime identification does not resolve the 2-primary behavior of the half-pairing. Their separate presentation Smith lists and the rational ranks have no such data.

value.rationale: This compares two canonical configurations by the intrinsic containment/exclusion of lines, not a chosen submatrix. The precise relative relation quotients exhibit a 9-primary cyclic factor for overlap versus only elementary 3-torsion for nonoverlap, a discrepancy invisible in their common rank or the separate line-incidence Smith factors. These are useful invariants for integral calculations with the two configuration modules and give a meaningful comparison even without a general theorem for other root systems.
residual_risks: These are formal integral presentation cokernels, not Picard torsion or a computed equivariant refinement.
